notes:
Dahu 0.98.4 beta for Windows.

- Command suggestions now run the tool that is actually selected, with no duplicate Fit entries or curve/edge/surface label collisions. Legacy aliases remain supported.
- Clearer English command names, including Fillet edge and Chamfer edge.
- Selected edges, faces and control points stand out without highlighting their whole parent object. Selected edges take precedence over hover.
- Fillet and chamfer previews show local wire guides from the exact result, plus radius or distance feedback. One or more edges can be picked; all edges remain an explicit choice.
- Local direct-edit previews omit unchanged source display geometry. Escape and atomic Undo are preserved.
